focus.name: scene-resource-mode-record-table
focus.purpose: Bound the fixed scene-resource mode record table consumed by SceneResource_InstantiateActors and document its 12-byte record fields and following text boundary.

following_object.description: ASCII scene/menu text begins immediately after the final 12-byte record.

consumer.name: SceneResource_InstantiateActors
consumer.indexing: Reads SCENE_RESOURCE_MODE, multiplies it by 12 through 68000 byte arithmetic, adds 0x00126D7E, then consumes the four fields in order.

evidence: SceneResource_InstantiateActors adds the exact 12-byte stride to the table base.
The ROM contains 26 complete records from mode index 0 through 0x19.
The final record ends at 0x00126EB5 and the next object begins with text at 0x00126EB6.
The two directly selecting scene-resource callers publish modes 0x11 and 0x16, both within the table.
limitations: The higher-level user-facing meaning of every mode record remains separate from the table layout.
The command-stream extents pointed to by the records are not claimed by this slice.
